entries.name: Free Fire official site
entries.note: Garena's own home for the game: news, events, patch notes and downloads.

entries.name: Free Fire redeem codes
entries.note: The only safe place to redeem codes. Any other redeem site asking for your login is a scam.

entries.name: Free Fire Advance Server
entries.note: Garena's test server. Sign up with your Facebook or Google account and try new features before they ship.

entries.name: Garena Free Fire Global
entries.note: The official YouTube channel: trailers, event cinematics and patch previews.

entries.name: Garena player support
entries.note: Account recovery, ban appeals and bug reports, straight from Garena.

entries.name: FreeFireHub player tracker
entries.note: Look up any player by nickname or UID: BR and Clash Squad stats, K/D, rank and loadout.

entries.name: Free Fire Info
entries.note: UID lookup with the deep details: account creation date, Booyah Pass, guild, equipped outfits and pet.

entries.name: Free Fire Jornal profile tool
entries.note: Paste a player ID and get a full profile page: ranks, guild, likes and match history. No login needed, and never enter your password on a lookup page.

entries.name: FF Stats
entries.note: Android app for the same UID and nickname lookups when you would rather check on your phone.

entries.name: SensiAI Pro
entries.note: Sensitivity and DPI calculator that takes your phone's RAM, refresh rate and playstyle and gives you starting values plus HUD button sizes. Starting points only, tune them in Training Mode.

entries.name: Free Fire sensitivity settings guide
entries.note: Plain-English explainer of every sensitivity slider, with recommended ranges for beginners, rushers and snipers.

entries.name: BlueStacks Free Fire MAX 240 FPS guide
entries.note: How to run Free Fire MAX at up to 240 FPS on PC through BlueStacks, with mouse sensitivity values that actually work.

entries.name: Battlefy
entries.note: Tournament brackets and registrations for community-run events, including Free Fire brackets.

entries.name: Gamerji
entries.note: Indian esports platform with regular Free Fire tournaments and prize pools. Some tournaments have a paid entry.

entries.name: game.tv
entries.note: Run or join tournaments from your phone, with Discord integration for guild events.

entries.name: Discord
entries.note: Where almost every Free Fire guild actually lives: voice comms for matches, announcements and scrims.

entries.name: OBS Studio
entries.note: Free and open source recording and streaming. What most Free Fire streamers use to go live.

entries.name: CapCut
entries.note: Quickest way to cut a match into a Short: auto-captions, templates, and it runs on phone and desktop.

entries.name: Canva
entries.note: Thumbnails, tournament posters and guild banners without opening Photoshop.

entries.name: Streamlabs
entries.note: Overlays, alerts and widgets for your stream, plus a mobile app to stream straight from your phone.

entries.name: Aim Lab
entries.note: Aim trainer with tasks you can bend towards flicks and tracking. Useful on PC days; your phone aim still needs in-game practice.

entries.name: 3D Aim Trainer
entries.note: Browser-based aim trainer, nothing to install. Good for warming up your flicks before a match.

entries.name: Free Fire Wiki
entries.note: Community wiki for characters, pets, weapons, maps and events. First stop when a patch drops and you want to know what changed.

entries.name: Liquipedia Free Fire
entries.note: The competitive record: tournament results, team rosters and player pages for the pro scene.

entries.name: r/freefire
entries.note: The main English-speaking Free Fire community on Reddit: clips, questions, patch talk and the occasional leak that turns out real.

entries.name: Sportskeeda Free Fire
entries.note: News, guides and redeem-code roundups. Solid for keeping up with events if you don't follow every creator.

entries.name: Free Fire Mania
entries.note: Brazilian Free Fire news site, in Portuguese. Brazil is the heart of the competitive scene, so this is often where news breaks first.

entries.name: Free Fire MAX
entries.note: The game itself on Google Play, for the friend who still hasn't installed it.

meta.rule: Legit only. No mods, no injectors, no panels, no diamond generators, nothing that breaks Garena's terms. If it can get your account banned, it is not on this list.
